text:
Ava (Marketing): Heads up team — planning a short-form announce for v2 improvements. Target publish: Wed 9:00am PT. Need: public changelog URL, live docs link, short benchmark blurb (2-3 sentences), and confirm canary + lead routing for demo CTA. Can we lock this by Tue EOD?
Ravi (Eng): Tue EOD freeze is doable. We'll run a 5% canary initially and escalate if no errors. Draft changelog at https://internal.redwood/changelog/v2-draft-2026 — will make public when PR merges.
Maya (Docs): I'll prep the public docs page and an FAQ blurb about quantization and batching effects. Plan to publish Tue 8:30am PT so marketing can link it. Need the final API snippet from @Ravi.
Tori (Bench): Uploaded the benchmark summary (spreadsheet + short notes) here: https://drive.google.com/benchmarks/v2-summary. Highlights: p50 ~1.9x better on small prompts, p95 varies by load but up to 2.1x lower with conservative batching. I'll add a 2-sentence narrative for the blog.
Ava (Marketing): Good. For messaging prefer relative claims (e.g., "up to 2x faster p50") and one line about tradeoffs for long-sequence workloads. Also want a 30s webinar teaser on the page linking to signup.
Ravi (Eng): API snippet ready in PR #1987. Canary config we'll deploy as: ```json
{"rollout": {"canary_fraction": 0.05, "fallback": "v1"}}
```
DeployBot: Canary rollout scheduled 2026-05-14T16:00:00Z by @Ravi
Liam (Sales): For inbound demo routing, can we add a hidden form field that flags enterprise interest and posts to our sales webhook? I can wire the webhook and own follow-ups.
Ava (Marketing): Yes — CTA = "Request a dedicated demo" -> https://redwood.ai/demo. Add hidden field "lead_tier=enterprise". @Liam please confirm webhook URL.
Liam (Sales): Confirmed. Webhook: https://hooks.redwood.ai/sales/demo-enqueue. I'll set auto-assign to the enterprise queue.
Maya (Docs): Published staging -> https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/v2/optimize. Will flip to prod once PR merge confirmed. Added changelog anchor and FAQ.
Ravi (Eng): PR merged, changelog public: https://redwood.ai/changelog/v2. Canary rollout started, monitoring dashboards green so far.
Tori (Bench): Quick update: fixed minor noise in 32k token tests; final narrative now includes canary numbers and a short note on quantized model accuracy variance.
Ava (Marketing): Draft announcement copy posted in the google doc: https://docs.google.com/announce-v2-draft. Please leave comments by Tue 5pm PT. I'll coordinate embargo: press embargo -> Tue 8:30am PT.
Liam (Sales): Webinar scheduled Fri 10am PT, registration page and calendar invites done. I'll co-present with @Ava.
Ravi (Eng): One more ops note: we'll enable a temporary rollback flag if error rate > 0.5% during canary. Configured in prod.
DeployBot: Deployment completed 2026-05-14T16:12:00Z (canary 5%).
Ava (Marketing): Final checklist: changelog live? docs prod? canary set? webhook tested? webinar + signup live? press embargo set?
Ravi (Eng): Changelog live: yes. Docs prod: yes. Canary set: yes. Webhook tested: yes.
Liam (Sales): Webinar + signup live: yes. RSVP counts looking good.
Ava (Marketing): Thanks all — I'll schedule the publish for Wed 9:00am PT and distribute embargo instructions to press list. :rocket:
